cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I can't open the cupboard. Was the sofa this close yesterday?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's more room for yoga now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Did making that room involve moving the sofa?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, I moved it. I put the things you'll need somewhere easier.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. Would those be the mugs in your sock drawer, or has someone else improved the kitchen too?
